name: Anaswara Rajan
bio:
Anaswara Rajan (born September 8, 2002) is an Indian actress who works predominantly in Malayalam cinema, alongside appearances in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi films. She made her acting debut as a child artist in *Udaharanam Sujatha* (2017) and played her first leading role in the coming-of-age film *Thanneer Mathan Dinangal* (2019).

Her subsequent Malayalam releases included *Adhyarathri* (2019), *Vaanku* (2021), *Super Sharanya* (2022), and *Mike* (2022). She made her Tamil debut in *Raangi* (2022), followed by *Thugs* (2023), and made her Hindi film debut in *Yaariyan 2* (2023). For her performance in the courtroom drama *Neru* (2023), she won the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actress – Malayalam and the SIIMA Award for Best Actress – Malayalam.

Over the following years, her credits included *Abraham Ozler* (2024), *Malayalee from India* (2024), and *Guruvayoor Ambalanadayil* (2024). She appeared in *Rekhachithram* (2025) and made her Telugu cinema debut in *Champion* (2025).
